quests.title: Little Lantern, Little Wish

dialogue.t: Xiao Lanterns are soooo hard to make...
Do you know how to make Xiao Lanterns? I keep trying but I can't do it...
Through the hole, then back around, and then... I drop it. Or it breaks.
I really wanted to make a Xiao Lantern for Yu...
Yu always has to look after the tea shop, so he never has any time to play or to make a lantern.
But I bet he still has a wish. So I wanna make a lantern for him...

dialogue.sit: I can make one for you.

dialogue.t: But, but... I wanted to be the one to make it for him...
And, and... I wanna know the secrets to making them so I can tell Yu, too.
Could you... teach me how to make them?
Yay!
So, so... Then the Xiao Lantern is ready, right?
Thanks! I'm gonna go make one for Yu now!
H—Hi... Sir or Madam, um, um... Please put your feet up, and please have some tea, and...

dialogue.sit: We're here to give you a Xiao Lantern.

dialogue.t: ...Really?
Yu, the Xiao Lantern's for you.
Mengmeng? Oh, did you make this...? Wow... thank you...
This nice man(nice lady) taught me how to make them. Actually, it's one of my first, so I didn't do a great job... D—Do you like it...?
Are you kidding? It's great, I love it! I was just starting to worry when I'd have the time to make one for myself...
Thanks, Mengmeng. I'll find someone to hang it on my door in a bit.

dialogue.sit: Can't someone in your family help?

dialogue.t: Well, the thing is... My dad's not in great health, so he can't hang it up for me. And I'm too short, so I wouldn't be able to reach...
So, if I wanna hang it on the door, I gotta ask someone around here if they can help...
Really? You sure you don't mind helping? ...That's great, thanks! Now I don't need to worry about who'd watch the shop if I went off looking for someone to help...
Thank you so much.
Thanks for your help...
This Xiao Lantern looks so pretty! Thanks so much, Sir(Ma'am)!
Come on, Yu... Let's go and play. I know a great place with the prettiest flowers.
This nice man(nice lady) taught me how to make Xiao Lanterns, and when we get there I can teach you, too. C'mon, wouldn't that be great?
I, uh... I can't. I need to watch the shop. Even though there's no customers, I've gotta keep the place spick and span, just like my dad always says.
Okay, well... Scrap the Xiao Lanterns, how about we just go there, have a quick chat, then come back straight away? That way, it won't waste too much of your time.
But...

dialogue.sit: I can clean the shop for you.

dialogue.t: ...Oh? Y—You sure? That, uh... That's asking a lot of you...
We'll be really quick, we'll just go straight there and come straight back. Promise it won't take too long!
Thanks soooo much!
It looks like the two of them are still playing. Guess we don't have to worry.
But given the atmosphere... Maybe we shouldn't disturb them.
If we made a garland for your dad, do you think he'd get better quicker?
I... I don't know...
I read in a book that if you stay happy, even if you get sick, you'll get better really quickly.
I think that you're so grown-up, the way you help your dad watch the shop every day... And I'm sure that must make him very happy.
But sometimes he tells me off... "Stop lounging around in the shop, go off and play"...
"If you don't go and play with Mengmeng, she'll pick the whole neighborhood bare of flowers"...
That would never happen, there's soooo many flowers around here... Wait a second, I'll make a garland for you.
Thanks, Mengmeng. I should be getting back.
Huh, okay... Well, once your dad's recovered, you'll have more time, right? Then I can come play with you again...
Yep, I'm sure dad will make a quick recovery...
What the...!? Wh—When did you get here?
Uhh... Uhhhh... I—I...
Happy Lantern Rite to you, too!
Ha—Happy Lantern Rite...
Um, well, thanks for your help. Please take these as a thank-you. Dad says that you should always give people something in return for their help.
Let's head back to the shop... Come on, Mengmeng.
Yep, let's head back. Thanks again!

quests.description: Mengmeng seems to be troubled by something…
